Dataset Summary
	

This is a copy of the full ImageNet dataset consisting of all of the original 21841 clases. It also contains labels in a separate field for the '12k' subset described at at (https://github.com/rwightman/imagenet-12k, https://huggingface.co/datasets/timm/imagenet-12k-wds)
This dataset is from the original fall11 ImageNet release which has been replaced by the winter21 release which removes close to 3000 synsets containing people, a number of these are of an offensive… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/timm/imagenet-22k-wds.
